note: views_filters_summary_verf is a thin integration submodule of views_filters_summary. It has NO config, routes, permissions, or plugins; it only implements the alter hook(s) hook_views_filters_summary_info_alter (primary: views_filters_summary_info_alter) to let the parent's Views summary area render Views Entity Reference Filter's filters. Companion module: verf. Grounding: easy = code facts about the hook/behaviour; medium = live module-registry introspection (declared dependencies and the implemented hook, discoverable via the extension list / module source without the companion being active); hard = building/altering the parent views_filters_summary area on a real view (vfs_task / vfs_reset), verified against live view config — since the submodule's own effect only manifests when its companion module plus a matching exposed filter render inside that area.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal submodule views_filters_summary_verf do, and which companion module (if any) does it integrate the Views Filters Summary with?
evals.expected_output: Renders referenced entity labels in the summary for the Views Entity Reference Filter (VERF) filter. Dependencies: views_filters_summary, verf.

evals.prompt: Which views_filters_summary alter hook (or core hook) does the views_filters_summary_verf submodule implement to do its job, and what does that implementation do?
evals.expected_output: It implements hook_views_filters_summary_info_alter. This submodule implements `hook_views_filters_summary_info_alter()`. For the `verf` filter it reads the filter's `verf_target_entity_type_id`, loads each selected referenced entity, and sets the summary values to their labels, so the summary shows readable entity names. Requires the Views Entity Reference Filter (verf) module.

evals.prompt: In the views_filters_summary_verf submodule, describe the specific mapping or transformation it applies for its supported filter type in the Views Filters Summary.
evals.expected_output: This submodule implements `hook_views_filters_summary_info_alter()`. For the `verf` filter it reads the filter's `verf_target_entity_type_id`, loads each selected referenced entity, and sets the summary values to their labels, so the summary shows readable entity names. Requires the Views Entity Reference Filter (verf) module.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the module registry / extension info for views_filters_summary_verf and report the module(s) it declares as dependencies in its info file.
evals.expected_output: views_filters_summary_verf declares these dependencies: views_filters_summary, verf (readable via the extension list, e.g. \Drupal::service('extension.list.module')->getAllAvailableInfo()['views_filters_summary_verf']['dependencies'], or the module's .info.yml).

evals.prompt: On this site, inspect the views_filters_summary_verf submodule and report which views_filters_summary (or core) alter hook it implements.

The views_filters_summary_verf submodule enhances the parent views_filters_summary area. On this site there is a view 'vfs_task' with an exposed Title filter but no filters summary. Add the 'Views exposed filters summary' area handler (plugin id views_filters_summary) to a display of that view and save it.
evals.expected_output: Add a handler with plugin_id 'views_filters_summary' under display_options.footer (or header/empty) of the vfs_task view and save it.

evals.prompt: On this site the view 'vfs_reset' shows a filters summary (the kind views_filters_summary_verf enhances) but has no reset-all link. Turn on the reset-all link for that summary and save the change.
evals.expected_output: Set the views_filters_summary area's show_reset_link option to TRUE on the vfs_reset view and save.
